key.name: open-window-menu
key.summary: Open the window menu for the focused window
key.description: Opens the shell window menu (with color swatches) even for CSD windows like Chrome that have no server-side titlebar.

key.name: cycle-color
key.summary: Cycle the color tag on the focused window
key.description: Steps through the palette on the focused window; after the last color the tag is cleared.
